results.answer: Neither Upwork nor Fiverr pays the assistant instantly, and both make the hiring client pay first. On Upwork the client funds an escrowed milestone before work starts, and after approval or a 14-day auto-release the funds sit in a 5-day security hold. On Fiverr the client pays upfront, and earnings clear 14 days after completion (7 days for Seller Plus/Top Rated/Pro). The PeoplePerHour terms could not be opened. The premise that some platform allows per-task instant payout without the hirer's money up front is not supported.

results.answer: All three can pay out the same day for a fee. Stripe: 2.9% + 30¢ per domestic card, standard payout in 2 business days (the first payout typically takes 7-14 days), Instant Payouts at 1.5% (50¢ minimum) within about 30 minutes, but new users are not immediately eligible. PayPal: 3.49% + $0.49 for checkout or commercial payments, 2.99% for goods and services, instant transfer at 1.5% (50¢ minimum), but new sellers' first payments can be held up to 21 days. Square: 3.3% + 30¢ for online and invoice payments on the free plan, next-business-day deposit, instant transfer at 1.95%.

results.answer: Premise partly false: the Fiverr Revenue Card was discontinued in December 2022 (existing holders only), and the buyer's payment method does not change seller payout timing. After delivery, the order auto-completes in 3 days unless the buyer acts (review can be extended by 5 days). Revenue then clears 14 days after completion (7 days for Seller Plus/Top Rated/Pro), and PayPal withdrawal takes about 24 hours. A new seller's typical order-to-cash is therefore about 17-18+ days, well over 7 days. Early Payout (1% fee, can be immediate) is limited to Top Rated and Seller Plus Premium sellers.
